cues: During a laptop repair, a technician removes tiny case screws with a magnetic precision tool.
The flat blade slips into a slotted head while replacing a loose switch plate.
In the workshop, a cross-shaped tip turns fasteners securing a wooden cabinet hinge.
A repair kit includes interchangeable bits for opening phones without damaging their small casing screws.
Before painting, she loosens the screw holding each brass door handle in place.
The electrician tightens terminal screws inside an outlet after switching off the circuit breaker.
A carpenter uses a stubby handle to reach screws behind a crowded drawer rail.
The magnetic tip holds a tiny screw steady while the watchmaker reassembles the clockwork housing.
